Two independent signed-trace methods agree on all fourteen classes.

value.rationale: The Desargues graph is the canonical bipartite double cover of the Petersen graph; computing its full rational S5 x C2 action answers a natural symmetry problem inaccessible from Betti numbers alone. The uniform negative deck involution and difference between S5, A5 and full/deck quotient cohomology are structural consequences of this natural representation.
